description:
Mint one free PayCheck API key. The key looks like pc_live_ followed by hex and raises the merchant-check allowance from 100 to 1,000 per UTC day.

Use this once when you set up a long-running agent, then store the key and pass it on later check_merchant or get_quota calls. The plaintext key is returned only in this response. PayCheck stores a SHA-256 hash.

Do not call this every turn. Do not call it to score a payee or to dodge a block verdict. Minting is free and is not an x402 check, and it is limited to 10 new keys per caller IP per UTC day. A new key does not change any merchant score. Checks above the free daily cap still cost $0.001 USDC on Base via x402.

Returns: api_key, token_type (bearer), daily_limit (1000), prefix, note.
name: get_api_key
title: Get API key
